sliding_friction.basis: Rounded lower end of measured snooker sliding interval 0.178–0.245 in Mathavan et al. 2010 section 3.2, reporting their high-speed-camera experiments. Transfer reference, not a pool-brand measurement.

rolling_friction.basis: Engineering selection toward faster cloth within Alciatore published pool range 0.005–0.015. Defined here as effective linear deceleration / g, not tangential force / normal force. NOT a directly measured value for this table.

spin_deceleration.basis: Retained within published pool range 5–15 rad/s^2. Acts on vertical side spin only, never on draw/follow rotation.

provenance.other_parameters: Retain v3 cushion and ball research values; no claim of a jointly measured table.

general_pool_cloth_v1.scope: Generic cloth reference and documented tuning; not restricted to JOY or Liber Win. Phase A retains its historical v3 baseline.
